Description: Unique site code (e.g. PB01 = Punjab site 1)
City or district name of the field site
Pakistani province: Punjab / Sindh / Balochistan / KPK
Growing season identifier (e.g. Kharif_2015)
Season category: kharif (May–Nov) or rabi (Nov–Apr)
Primary crop grown: wheat / rice / cotton / sugarcane / mango
Latitude of field site centroid
Longitude of field site centroid
Normalized Difference Vegetation Index — primary crop health indicator
Enhanced Vegetation Index — reduces atmosphere and soil noise vs NDVI
Normalized Difference Water Index — canopy water content
Normalized Difference Red Edge — sensitive to chlorophyll content
Leaf Area Index — estimated canopy density
Bare Soil Index — soil exposure fraction
Standard deviation of NDVI across n_images composited — temporal variability
Minimum seasonal NDVI
Maximum seasonal NDVI
Mean seasonal air temperature (season-type imputed from Open-Meteo climatology)
Total seasonal rainfall (season-type imputed from CHIRPS climatology)
Estimated soil moisture (linearly scaled from NDWI; range 16–28%)
Target class: Healthy / Stressed / Diseased (derived from tertile split on vegetation health composite 0.5·NDVI + 0.3·NDRE + 0.2·EVI)
